Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site assessments for all schools, with detailed condition assessments of major systems and connection to educational priorities (Sections 1.7, 2-11, 13). Includes detailed modernization history and proposed improvements integrating short- and long-term needs.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with methodology, including demographic and housing data; capacity utilization by site and grade; explicit connection to facility actions including new K-8 school and permanent classroom additions; adaptive uses discussed (Sections 1.5, 1.6, 12).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; comprehensive analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, dual language immersion, academies, and pathways (Sections 1.2, 13).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Some reference to outdoor spaces such as playfields, playgrounds, and shade structures; limited detail on greening or climate-adapted design; no districtwide data on green surfaces or detailed greening strategies (e.g., Sections 2-11 site assessments mention playfields and shade structures but no comprehensive greening plan).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan acknowledges climate control and HVAC needs with cost analyses and alternative climate control strategies; includes discussion of heat days and alternative cooling measures; however, lacks comprehensive climate risk assessment or districtwide climate resilience theme (Section 1.4).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as HVAC upgrades, technology infrastructure improvements, and references to energy resilience goals; some data on energy use and references to state requirements; lacks fully comprehensive energy resilience and electrification plan (Sections 14, 1.7).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased project prioritization, multiple funding sources including state grants, local bonds, developer fees; clear prioritization criteria and long-term financial sustainability considerations; includes voter survey and bond authorization strategy (Sections 14, 15).
